latestAIResult.summary: The Dunnett Classic Drums 2N Model 2N Aluminum Hammered snare drum features a hybrid bearing edge design with a straight edge on the snare side and a flanged edge on the batter side. It is equipped with deep, soft snare beds and 42-strand Dunnett Presence snare wires for enhanced sensitivity and response. The batter head is a Remo Coated Ambassador X, and the resonant head is a Dunnett Cristal Reso-O-Tone. Specific details regarding shell thickness and reinforcement rings are not provided in the available sources.
